dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Oh boy, you did not disappoint. This festive street is exactly my scene!

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: ...Time to get serious, though. Let's pick a stall and go head-to-head, winner takes it all!

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: The loser has to, uhh... has to run around the place three times while shouting to the winner, "All Hail, King of the Festival!"
